decision: No change shipped; three mechanisms discarded before implementation

hypotheses.reason: A 57%-accurate tiebreaker converts refusals into unsupported answers.
Real, and it motivated hypothesis 3 rather than a change of its own.
Tied regions are different sentences inside the same titled section, so the title matches all or none.

limitations: Development-split evidence; public synthetic sources only.
Bounds what these three mechanisms can do on this corpus; does not prove no mechanism exists.
what_this_rules_out: Any tiebreaker built from the question and candidate text alone. The tied candidates are equally covered, equally titled, and differ only in what they assert.
